description: Dismisses the health alert once all cameras are clear (down/frozen/slow all 0) for 5 min. No 'recovered' notification posted - avoids the recovery-message churn (10x last night) from transient blips. CLEAR GATE RAISED 5 -> 35 min (2026-08-27): the raise tiers run to 30 min but the clear ran at 5, so any fault whose quiet runs exceeded 5 min re-raised and re-cleared once per oscillation - one 7.3h fault produced 4 card appearances and 6 dismissals, with the card absent for 143 min during which the fault was active 81% of the time. 35 min sits above the longest raise tier AND above the freeze detector's own 10-min re-arm window (FREEZE_PROBES x scan_interval), so 'recovered' can no longer be asserted from an interval the detector is blind in.
